items.title: Pay outstanding debt-collection total
items.quote: Zahlen Sie den Gesamtbetrag spätestens am Mittwoch, 02.12.2026 auf unser Treuhandkonto.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for payment: Mittwoch, 02.12.2026. The sender is a private debt-collection company (Inkassobüro), not a German authority, so no statutory deemed-delivery rule applies; the date given is used directly. Verified that 2026-12-02 is indeed a Wednesday and not a public holiday in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. Due date = 2026-12-02 as stated in the letter.
